svg.aria-label: Three radar charts with ten spokes each, on measures where the three builds differ; on every spoke the best of the three reaches the outer ring. Left: the exact DLL (AMD's picture), middle: the steady test, right: the community bias DLL; in the middle and right charts the dashed outline is the exact DLL's shape. Bright flat areas at rest: change per frame (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 0.078, Steady test (this project) 0.008, Community bias DLL (0.5) 0.068. The same with auto exposure on (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 0.186, Steady test (this project) 0.051, Community bias DLL (0.5) 0.185. Moving background: change per frame (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 0.079, Steady test (this project) 0.067, Community bias DLL (0.5) 0.068. Thin railing in motion: change per frame (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 0.913, Steady test (this project) 0.906, Community bias DLL (0.5) 0.832. Fine stripes in motion: change per frame (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 2.04, Steady test (this project) 2.01, Community bias DLL (0.5) 1.74. Just uncovered at 1080p output, moving: accuracy (dB): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 32.61 dB, Steady test (this project) 32.67 dB, Community bias DLL (0.5) 32.85 dB. Thin wire under a slow pan: how close its brightness is to the true one (%): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 90.5%, Steady test (this project) 90.9%, Community bias DLL (0.5) 85.3%. Bright rain without motion vectors: pixels more than 20 of 255 off (per frame): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 1314, Steady test (this project) 403, Community bias DLL (0.5) 1810. A region dimming 1% per frame: frames behind, bright flat areas (frames): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 0.62, Steady test (this project) 0.90, Community bias DLL (0.5) 0.68. Film grain of 10 of 255: change per frame (of 255): Exact DLL (AMD's picture) 1.72, Steady test (this project) 1.72, Community bias DLL (0.5) 1.66.
svg.text: On every spoke the best of the three reaches the outer ring. Bigger is better. Dashed outline: the exact DLL.
Flat at rest, Fade, Grain, Uncovered 1080p, Wire, Bright rain: the full check of each build. Background, Railing, Stripes: the comparison rig's moving scene.
AE: the game's auto exposure flag on (the timing kit and many games set it). Everything else with it off.
Test rig, 4K output from 2260x1272, Radeon RX 7800 XT, single runs.
